# FanFan

> FanFan is a free, open-source (MIT) Mac fan control and temperature monitor that lives in the macOS menu bar. It shows CPU, GPU, SSD and battery temperatures and fan speeds; fans can be pinned to a fixed speed, follow a temperature-to-speed curve, or be handed back to macOS. FanFan 是免费开源的 Mac 风扇控制与温度监控菜单栏工具，支持 Apple Silicon 和 Intel。

Key facts:

- Website: https://hoobnn.github.io/fanfan/
- Source code: https://github.com/hoobnn/fanfan
- Download: https://github.com/hoobnn/fanfan/releases/latest (DMG, auto-updates via Sparkle)
- Install: `brew tap hoobnn/tap && brew install --cask fanfan`
- Requirements: macOS 26 or later; Apple Silicon or Intel. Fanless Macs (e.g. MacBook Air) only show temperatures.
- Price and license: free, MIT. No analytics; the only network activity is Sparkle update checks, which can be turned off.
- Fan modes: fixed RPM, automatic by strategy curve (Power Saving, Balanced, Performance, or custom), or macOS firmware control; per fan on two-fan Macs. Scheduled mode switching and high-temperature alerts.
- Safety: speeds are limited to the fan's reported min/max; fan speed is written by a small root helper (fanfan-smcd) over XPC, and the fans return to macOS control if the app quits, crashes or hangs for 10 seconds.
- Languages: 简体中文, 繁體中文, English, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Español
- Author: hoobnn (https://github.com/hoobnn, https://www.ikuyu.com)
